bonus_rules.label: Founder/co-founder
bonus_rules.description: Founded or co-founded a company and was responsible for building its product or technology; 2-3 if evidenced, otherwise 0. A personal project or freelance work alone does not qualify.

bonus_rules.label: Early-stage engineer
bonus_rules.description: Among the first 10-20 engineers at a startup and built core systems there; 1-2 if the resume states it, otherwise 0. Do not infer it from company size or the word startup alone.

bonus_rules.label: Open-source maintainer
bonus_rules.description: Maintainer or core contributor of an open-source project that other people use or contribute to; 2-3 if evidenced, otherwise 0. Individual merged pull requests to other projects belong in communication_community, not here.

bonus_rules.label: Patents or publications
bonus_rules.description: Granted patents, peer-reviewed papers, or published books on technical topics; 1-2 if evidenced, otherwise 0. Blog posts, talks and podcasts belong in communication_community, not here.
